title.zh: South Korean bank launches Bitcoin-backed business loans: Report
title.en: South Korean bank launches Bitcoin-backed business loans: Report

current_state.zh: South Korea's Jeonbuk Bank has reportedly begun offering Bitcoin-backed won-denominated loans to corporate customers, using a third-party custodian and relying on amended Civil Enforcement Rules that allow courts to seize and liquidate crypto collateral in case of default.
current_state.en: South Korea's Jeonbuk Bank has reportedly begun offering Bitcoin-backed won-denominated loans to corporate customers, using a third-party custodian and relying on amended Civil Enforcement Rules that allow courts to seize and liquidate crypto collateral in case of default.
